info.title: Docento API
info.description:
A self-hostable course platform.

Every response carries a `requestId` matching the server logs, which is what makes a user-reported failure findable.
Retryable mutations require an `idempotency-key` header: the same key twice produces one business effect.
Collections use cursor pagination.

license.name: AGPL-3.0-only for the application, Apache-2.0 for this SDK

learnerSession.name: docento-learner.session_token
learnerSession.description: A learner session issued by /api/auth/learners. Scoped to one academy; a token from another cannot resolve.

staffSession.name: docento-staff.session_token
staffSession.description: A staff session issued by /api/auth/staff. Spans workspaces; the active workspace lives on the session.

serviceKey.description: A service key (sk_…) for server-to-server calls. Carries scopes and never stands in for a person: billing, credentials and membership require a staff session.

publishableKey.name: x-publishable-key
publishableKey.description: A publishable key (pk_…) identifying an academy in a browser. Public by definition, and not an authenticator.
